strings.about.subtitle: Runtime and build details for support and debugging.
strings.about.title: About Mouser
strings.accessibility.text:
Mouser needs Accessibility permission to intercept mouse button events.

macOS should have opened the System Settings prompt.
Please grant permission, then restart Mouser.
strings.accessibility.title: Accessibility Permission Required
strings.haptic.actions_desc: Pick which actions fire haptic feedback. Click an action to move it between Enabled and Available.
strings.haptic.actions_empty: No actions selected. Pick from Available.
strings.haptic.buttons_desc: Choose which buttons fire haptic feedback, in addition to the action picker above.
strings.haptic.buttons_empty: No buttons selected. Pick from Available.
strings.haptic.dedup_desc: When two haptic events fire close together, play only one pulse. Disable to allow both.
strings.haptic.experimental_note: Haptic feedback support is experimental. Some settings may not take effect until the protocol is fully documented.
strings.haptic.level_desc: Choose how strongly the haptic motor responds. Higher levels use more battery.
strings.haptic.subtitle: Configure the haptic motor in your MX Master 4
strings.haptic.test_desc: Play a brief haptic pulse to preview the current intensity.
strings.haptic.title: Haptic Feedback
strings.key_capture.error.empty_segment: Use + only between keys. Type plus for the + key.
strings.key_capture.error.missing_main_key: Add a key, such as A, F5, or Page Down.
strings.key_capture.error.multiple_main_keys: Use one key with optional Ctrl, Shift, Alt, or Super.
strings.key_capture.error.unsupported_key: Choose a different key. %1 isn't available in Mouser.
strings.key_capture.record_hint: Press the keys you want. Modifier keys such as Win are captured here instead of reaching the system.
strings.key_capture.reserved_warning: The operating system may intercept this shortcut. It can still be saved, but behavior may vary by system.
strings.key_capture.title: Custom Shortcut
strings.key_capture.type_hint: Type the shortcut with + between keys, e.g. super+shift+f5.
strings.key_capture.valid_keys:
Valid keys: ctrl/control, shift, alt/option/opt, super (aliases: cmd, command, meta, win, windows),
0–9, a–z, f1–f24, space, tab, enter, esc, left, right, up, down, delete, ...
strings.mouse.add_app_dialog.desc: Choose an app. Mouser will switch to this profile when that app is focused.
strings.mouse.add_app_dialog.title: Add App Profile
strings.mouse.choose_layout: Choose a layout mode below while we build a dedicated overlay
strings.mouse.click_dot: Click a dot to configure its action
strings.mouse.configure_gesture: Configure tap behavior plus swipe actions for the gesture button
strings.mouse.configure_scroll_actions: Configure separate actions for scroll left and right
strings.mouse.connect_mouse_desc: Mouser will detect the active device, unlock button mapping, and enable the correct layout mode as soon as the mouse is available.
strings.mouse.debug_events_desc: Collects detected buttons, gestures, and mapped actions
strings.mouse.debug_placeholder: Turn on debug mode, then press buttons or use the gesture button.
strings.mouse.delete_dialog.desc: This removes its custom button mappings. The default profile will remain.
strings.mouse.delete_dialog.title: Delete profile?
strings.mouse.experimental_override_suffix: . Switch back to Auto-detect if the hotspot map does not line up.
strings.mouse.gesture_placeholder: Turn on Record and perform a few gesture attempts.
strings.mouse.search_installed_apps: Search installed apps or browse for one manually
strings.mouse.select_button_action: Select what happens when you use this button
strings.mouse.try_different: Try a different name, or use Browse to choose the app directly.
strings.mouse.turn_on_mouse: Turn on your Logitech mouse to start customizing buttons
strings.mouse.use_search: Use the search box above, or browse to choose an app directly.
strings.ring.hold_delay_desc: How long to hold the thumb button before the ring appears
strings.ring.slots_desc: Choose the actions available in each sector of the radial menu
strings.ring.subtitle: Configure hold delay and sector actions for the radial menu
strings.ring.title: Actions Ring
strings.scroll.appearance_desc: Choose whether Mouser follows the system, stays light, or stays dark.
strings.scroll.check_for_updates_desc: Notify when a newer Mouser release is available. Downloads and installation stay manual.
strings.scroll.dpi_note: DPI changes require HID++ communication with the device and will take effect after a short delay.
strings.scroll.ignore_trackpad_desc: Only respond to mouse events, not trackpad or Magic Mouse
strings.scroll.smooth_volume_desc: On: the thumb wheel slides the volume in smooth 2 % steps (one fast sweep covers 0-100). Off: Mouser mode, one 2 % step per scroll event.
strings.scroll.language_desc: Choose the display language for the application.
strings.scroll.pointer_speed_desc: Adjust the tracking speed of the sensor. Higher = faster pointer.
strings.scroll.pointer_speed_desc_range_prefix: Adjust the tracking speed of the sensor. This device supports
strings.scroll.screenshots_desc: Choose where Mouser saves screenshot file actions. Clipboard actions are unaffected.
strings.scroll.scroll_force_desc: Adjust the ratchet firmness of the scroll wheel. Lower = smooth and subtle, higher = firm and precise.
strings.scroll.scroll_speed_desc: Adjust how fast the page scrolls per wheel click. 1.0× is the system default.
strings.scroll.smart_shift_desc: Automatically switches the scroll wheel from line-by-line scrolling to hyper-fast scrolling when you scroll faster.
strings.scroll.smooth_scroll_desc: Add inertia so the page coasts to a stop after each wheel tick for a smoother feel.
strings.scroll.startup_desc: Start Mouser at login on supported desktop platforms, and choose whether the settings window opens on launch or Mouser stays in the system tray.
strings.scroll.subtitle: Adjust app preferences, pointer speed, screenshots, and scroll behaviour
strings.scroll.title: General Settings
strings.scroll.update_error_expired_metadata: Update details are out of date. Try again later.
strings.scroll.update_error_file_error: Mouser could not write the update files.
strings.scroll.update_error_install_failed: The update did not finish. Open the release page to install manually.
strings.scroll.update_error_metadata_invalid: Update details could not be read. Open the release page to install manually.
strings.scroll.update_error_metadata_missing: Update details are not ready yet. Open the release page to install manually.
strings.scroll.update_error_network_error: Mouser could not reach the update service. Try again later.
strings.scroll.update_error_permission_denied: Mouser does not have permission to prepare the update.
strings.scroll.update_error_sha256_mismatch: The download did not pass verification. Try again later.
strings.scroll.update_error_size_mismatch: The download did not pass verification. Try again later.
strings.scroll.update_idle: Mouser can check for new releases.
strings.scroll.update_manual: A new Mouser release is available. Download it from the release page and install manually.
strings.scroll.update_manual_linux: A new Mouser release is available. Download it from the release page and install manually on Linux.
strings.scroll.update_manual_macos: A new Mouser release is available. Download it from the release page and install manually on macOS.
strings.scroll.update_manual_windows: A new Mouser release is available. Download it from the release page and install manually on Windows.
strings.scroll.update_no_asset: No update package is available for this computer.
strings.scroll.update_ready: Ready to install after Mouser quits.
strings.scroll.wheel_mode_desc: Switch between tactile ratchet scrolling and smooth free-spin.
strings.tray.tray_message: Mouser is running in the system tray. Click the icon to open settings.
strings.tray.update_available: Mouser {version} is available. Open the release page to download it.
